raw.details:
Welcome to the INDIA GOT SPOT 1.0 - by Swastik Community

A team-based hackathon for bold ideas and practical solutions in Software Development.

About the Opportunity:

INDIA GOT SPOT 1.0 is an offline hackathon by Swastik Community, presented as an online coding challenge with team participation. It brings together participants to explore Software Development through ideation, problem-solving, technical communication, and solution-building.

Participants can showcase their skills in PowerPoint, Presentation Design, Ideation, Problem Solving, and Technical Communication. This is an opportunity to turn concepts into compelling project submissions, communicate innovation clearly, and demonstrate the technical thinking behind a solution.

Themes/Problem Statements:

While exact problems will be revealed to participants, this event focuses on areas related to Software Development:

  • Artificial Intelligence (AI)
  • Web Technologies
  • FinTech
  • Web3
  • Open Source
  • Other emerging domains

Competition Structure:

The structure for this online coding challenge is as follows:

  • Join our official WhatsApp group: Stay connected with event-related information, including important announcements, assignment updates, and submission guidelines for India Got Spot 1.0.
  • INDIA GOT SPOT 1.0 — Project Submission Round: Teams must submit one PowerPoint presentation of a maximum of six slides as their complete project submission. The first slide must include the team name, project or prototype name, GitHub repository link, working prototype link, and demo video link. The remaining slides should present the problem statement, proposed solution, key features, workflow, tech stack, USP or innovation, and impact.
  • Grand Offline Round of India Got Spot 1.0: Shortlisted participants come together for an exciting 12-hour hackathon organized by Swastik Community. This round centers on innovation, creativity, and technology across AI, Web Technologies, FinTech, Web3, Open Source, and other emerging domains.

Rewards and Prizes:

Rewards & prize details (as provided):

  • Winner: A cash reward of USD 3,588 along with a pre-placement offer.
  • First Runner-Up: A cash reward of USD 1,188 along with a pre-placement offer.
  • Second Runner-Up: A cash reward of USD 88 along with a pre-placement offer.
  • Participant Reward: A cash reward of USD 4,400 and a certificate for participants.

Bring your team, sharpen your ideas, and take the next step with INDIA GOT SPOT 1.0 by Swastik Community.
